text: Crying also contains a type of automatic erratic breathwork. Breathwork is one of the easiest ways I know to calm down. Reduced breathing or the Buteyko method is especially useful to me when my partner is getting me upset and flustered with drama. Sometimes she’s deliberately trying to do that, and other times it’s hard to tell. I explain more of the body-based options in my Somatic Modalities guide.
reader: Someone whose partner’s moods drag them down, deciding who to talk to and how to calm their body.
